observations.body: The chapter describes escalating consequences for refusal, exile and land rest, confession, and remembered covenants, closing as statutes made at Sinai.

payload.posture: Read Leviticus 26:14–46 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Refusal, escalating consequence, confession, and remembered covenant belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
